milestones.outcome: A repository can be normalized and saved durably under the exact displayed accepted sign-in authority without opening a PR.
exit_criteria: All four drafts and targeted amendments are registered with immutable baseline, complete bounded plan and no diagnostic logs/private payload in commits.
Direct input admission, saving/duplicate/refusal/retry and exact-authority replacement pass through the existing host/store; SQLite reopen and profile-window delivery preserve the same record.
milestones.boundary: Domain/host foundation only; Home/Settings dialog, setup/sign-in UI, composed rendering and owner acceptance remain next milestone obligations.

milestones.outcome: Home and Settings share focused addition with honest discovery and owner-judged native surfaces.
exit_criteria: Every RFC0062 criterion passes on exact public/runtime evidence or remains pending with candidate identity; no human verdict is inferred.
Operator and Home documentation match; formal closeout is dependency-truthful.
milestones.boundary: Finish all independent unattended work before parking exact visual candidate; coordinator owns wait.

milestones.outcome: Normal Overview has a larger resizable summary, independent scrolling and per-window persistence.
exit_criteria: Every RFC0063 criterion passes, including retained reading/file identity and required owner judgment.
New normal-view contract supersedes compact-preview selection without rewriting historical plans or accepted cards.
milestones.boundary: One Overview boundary with exact frozen rendered candidate.

milestones.outcome: Diagnostic Save starts in an eligible OS user folder and preserves existing export authority.
exit_criteria: Every RFC0064 criterion passes with actual native chooser location on each claimed platform.
Help/Settings, both privacy modes and controlled fallback/refusal retain exact frozen bytes and no discovery writes.
milestones.boundary: No persistent directory preference or automatic save.

milestones.outcome: Both real GHES failure classes have attributable bounded facts and composed synthetic reproducers.
exit_criteria: Actual selected tool/build facts are distinguished from reported/local-shell facts; missing paths or native qualification stay pending.
Qualification failure and actor-login conflict have separate public reproducers and no committed private payload.
milestones.boundary: Evidence foundation; implementation chooses repair only from established facts.

milestones.outcome: Precise installed-tool qualification and actor-provenance repair restore exact source with honest recovery.
exit_criteria: RFC0065 AC01–AC04 and AC06 pass with installed-tool acquisition and composed source evidence.
All existing confinement, bounds, identity, cancellation and relationship checks remain; adopted qualification clauses are reconciled to actual evidence.
milestones.boundary: Finish both repairs and independent verification before read-only owner acceptance.

milestones.outcome: The affected real enterprise PR renders on the exact repaired candidate and pack acceptance is truthful.
exit_criteria: RFC0065 AC05 has actual owner observation of its exact frozen candidate; private target/logs stay outside commits.
All four RFC closeouts, documentation gate, obligations, writer/command state and cleanup are reconciled before declaring pack complete.
milestones.boundary: Final whole-pack boundary; no live write or release publication.
